strings.dialogue.guide_intro.1: Welcome to town! Everyone here keeps a little garden of their own.
strings.dialogue.guide_intro.2: Head west and find Farmer Tu — he will show you how to plant.
strings.dialogue.shop_hello.1: Take a look around, we got a few good things today.
strings.dialogue.cosmetic_hello.1: New hairstyle? I just got fresh designs in.
strings.dialogue.arcade_hello.1: Care to test yourself against the critters in this machine?
strings.dialogue.arcade_hello.2: Match three of a colour to strike. Four or five hits far harder.
strings.dialogue.farm_intro.1: The soil is ready — just sow the seeds and give them time.
strings.dialogue.farm_intro.2: Sell your harvest at the market, or keep it for quests.
strings.dialogue.forest_intro.1: The deep woods hold good things, and a few that dislike visitors.
